title: Phylogenetic tree demonstrating the relationship between the 16S in Polychromophilus melanipherus and haemoplasma infections not associated with clinical signs in southern bent-winged bats (Miniopterus orianae bassanii) and eastern bent-winged bats (Miniopterus orianae oceanensis)
author: Holz, Peter H.
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Run MrBayes phylogenetic analysis
steps.instruction: Generate a phylogenetic tree using MrBayes v3.2.6 with the specified parameters and model.

substeps.instruction: Load the aligned 16S rRNA gene sequences into MrBayes.
Set the substitution model to Hasegawa‑Kishino‑Yano (HKY) with gamma‑distributed rate variation across sites.
Set the chain length to 1,000,000 generations.
Define a burn‑in of 10% of the sampled trees.
Export the resulting tree, displaying branch support values as posterior probabilities and annotate each tip with its GenBank accession number.
